title: alsine decandra
intro: Alsine decandra, commonly known as Creeping Cinquefoil or Five-fingered Clover, is a perennial plant belonging to the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Alsine decandra include its use in treating various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
